# Cold email (Corey Haines)

Writes B2B cold outreach and follow-ups, and covers deliverability.

- Source: https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills/main/skills/cold-email/SKILL.md
- Author: Corey Haines
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/cold-email-corey-haines-811a8dd9

Claude writes cold emails that read like a peer rather than a vendor: personalization tied to the prospect's problem, one low-friction ask, subject lines and follow-up sequences. It also covers sending from secondary domains, verifying lists, turning off open tracking, coordinating with LinkedIn and handling replies. It lists phrasing to avoid, including common AI tells.

**Try asking:**
- "Write a 3-email cold sequence to heads of RevOps at Series B SaaS companies"
- "Why is nobody replying to this cold email? Here it is"
- "Set up our sending domains and cadence for a new outbound campaign"
